shortDescription: LG’s Zero Clearance™ Hinge System and thin door design brings the nearly built-in look to your kitchen without the built-in price. Now, you can install it near flush and still fully open both French doors with virtually no extra clearance needed¹, even next to a wall or surrounding cabinetry. This sleek 4-door refrigerator expands versatility with a large 22 cu. ft. capacity and includes a Full-Convert® Drawer, with customizable temperatures settings, perfect for chilling wine or storing deli and snacks. This refrigerator not only provides everyday crushed and Mini Craft Ice™ but also produces LG’s SIGNATURE’s, slow-melting Big Craft Ice™.

features.text: Doors are 45% thinner so they take up less space while still providing the same daily ice production, easy ice and water access and energy efficiency you expect from LG. Combined with the zero clearance hinge system, you’ll enjoy a seamless, nearly built-in look like no other freestanding refrigerator.

Dual ice makers dispense ice from the door and provide additional ice from the freezer compartment, giving you convenient access to crushed ice, Mini Craft Ice™, and Big Craft Ice™. The added ice storage ensures you always have plenty on handwhether it’s a hot summer day or you’re entertaining large parties.
Elevate your space with an impressive 6.8" LCD touch display that lets you activate your combination wall oven with a few simple touches. And it doesn’t just look impressive it’s also easy to clean.

From pitchers to pint glasses, finally an ice & water dispenser that can accommodate just about any container. The water and ice dispenser in this LG French Door refrigerator is one of the tallest around, measuring in at an ultra-accommodating 12.6 inches.
More Ice When You Need It
Still need more ice? Turn on IcePlus™ to kick ice production into high gear by automatically lowering freezer temperatures to the coldest setting for 24 hours.
